title: Base overlays could flag a new exported symbol whose only test sits in an importer, so a "no test covers it" note on the defining package is not misread

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-194957-90f9, project ork, item S538:

Base overlays could flag a new exported symbol whose only test sits in an importer, so a "no test covers it" note on the defining package is not misread

Evidence: overlay-1 for internal/daemon says no test covers runs.go, but TestRenderWaitPausesUsePausedNext in internal/cli covers it and fails to build with it reverted
